args.message:
Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)

FIN-212 requires ROUND_HALF_EVEN, but round_money was using
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the nightly build to fail on
tests/test_money.py. Switch the import and quantize call to
ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.head: fix/banker-rounding
args.title: Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Change

- Switch `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (import and `quantize` call), matching the documented FIN-212 behavior.

## Testing

- CI run `ci-0001` on branch `fix/banker-rounding` passed.
